comment: Thresholds for the deviation of the planar wave through a Drucker-Prager
material without yield, a Maxwell body in shear, from its exact solution
as SeisSol splits its steps (see run_case.plastic_wave and
seissol_add_plastic_wave), keyed by case and build configuration. The
stress and the velocity at the receivers are relative to the amplitude of
the initial wave, the energies (energy-) and the plastic moment relative
to the largest value of their exact series.
